content.introduction: The upcoming US earnings season will test the resilience of war-rattled stocks, with S&P 500 earnings expected to rise about 14% in the first quarter. Key reports from Goldman Sachs and JPMorgan are set for Monday and Tuesday, respectively, alongside major earnings from Netflix, J&J, and PepsiCo. Economic data, including the Producer Price Index (PPI), will also be closely watched.
